notices.vendor_name: Community Agency for Senior Citizens Inc
notices.plain: The Department for the Aging awarded Community Agency for Senior Citizens Inc a $25,500 contract for health insurance counseling assistance for older New Yorkers in fiscal year 2026-27, through a required source the law directs the city to use.

notices.short_title: Mobility Data Platform services

notices.short_title: IT Consulting Services for Enterprise Document Automation
notices.plain: The Human Resources Administration awarded V Group Inc a $319,040 contract for IT consulting services for enterprise document automation, bought through a contract another government already holds.

notices.short_title: Legal Wallet Folders
notices.plain: The Kings County District Attorney's Office is seeking bids for legal wallet folders, with the lowest qualified bid to win, and responses are due May 5, 2026.

notices.short_title: Laptop for Operational Continuity and Capacity Expansion
notices.plain: New York City Emergency Management awarded Compulink Technologies Inc $99,587 for a laptop, in a small purchase from a certified minority- or women-owned business made without competition.

notices.short_title: Electrical Contracting Services in Manhattan and Bronx
notices.plain: The Fire Department awarded Polaris Electrical Construction Inc. a $9.1 million contract for electrical work in Manhattan and the Bronx, chosen through competitive sealed bids in which the lowest qualified bid wins.

notices.short_title: Shelters for Homeless Single Adults
notices.plain: The Department of Homeless Services awarded Bronx Parent Housing Network Inc a $70,980,345 contract to run shelters for homeless single adults, chosen from competing proposals among vendors the city approved in advance.

notices.short_title: NAE with Bridge, Inc. - Marmion Safe Haven Shelter
notices.plain: The Department of Homeless Services intends to award a negotiated contract to Bridge, Inc. to run the Marmion Safe Haven Shelter, with responses due April 21, 2026.

notices.short_title: Outreach - Value Engineering/Value Analysis Services
notices.plain: The Office of Management and Budget is seeking competing proposals, due June 1, 2026, for outreach services in value engineering and value analysis, a process for reviewing projects to cut costs while keeping their function.

notices.short_title: CAPPRJ-Caper Stacking Chairs for Mary Cali Recreation Center

notices.short_title: Licensing to Exhibit Motion Pictures and TV Programming

notices.short_title: Renovation, operation and maintenance of an indoor tennis and sports facility at the Cunningham Park Tennis Courts in Queens
notices.plain: The Department of Parks and Recreation is seeking proposals, due May 12, 2026, from vendors to renovate, operate and maintain an indoor tennis and sports facility at the Cunningham Park Tennis Courts in Queens.

notices.short_title: 3D7 - Disc Amendment
